searchText: If 25% of the validators on the merge testnet go offline due to bad configurations (and assuming the validators that bother to be on testnets are the better ones) that’s pretty bad 😅 Not sure how accurate low quality crypto news is though. https://timestabloid.com/sepolia-testnet-runs-through-the-merge-successfully-details/ This configuration issue is caused by abusing TTD override flag, the reason of using it inappropriately was protecting Sepolia Merge from hash rate spikes which could have caused early merge transition, this will not happen with Mainnet. With misconfiguration in this particular way as the only issue, Sepolia Merge should be considered as a big success Indeed if that’s so I agree Really hope validators all test their setups and pay attention to the merge 😅 I’m expecting a significant chunk to not though For the Mainnet real TTD value will be a part of clients binary. Node operators will only need to upgrade their software, no TTD override tweaks are expected in a normal scenario

Not sure how accurate low quality crypto news is though.
